jobs.description:
As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.

• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.

• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards

• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the events industry, specialising in the design and manufacture of exhibition stand systems. The company is renowned for its innovative approach and high-quality products, which are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions and events.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

You will be responsible for providing technical support within an automated production environment, which includes CNC machines, robots, milling machines and sawing machines. In the event of malfunctions, you will analyse and resolve the problem as efficiently as possible, whilst also carrying out preventive maintenance and making improvements to the machinery. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, thorough training and ongoing support within a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

• You analyze finance and controlling processes and translate business requirements into functional SAP solutions 

• You configure and optimize SAP FICO processes and contribute to the development of a standardized SAP template 

• You actively participate in blueprint, fit-gap, and implementation projects 

• You prepare functional and technical specifications and follow them through testing and go-live 

• You support the business during user acceptance testing and post-implementation support 

• You collaborate with business process owners, key users, and IT colleagues 

• You contribute to third-line support and the continuous improvement of the SAP landscape 

• You work with modern SAP technologies, including SAP S/4HANA 

• ... 
 

• You hold a master’s or bachelor’s degree 

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a SAP FICO Consultant or SAP Business Analyst 

• You have a thorough knowledge of Finance and Controlling processes within SAP 

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment is a plus 

• You are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented 

• You are able to work independently but also function effectively within a team 

• You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe 

• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus

Our client is a logistics trading company based in Breda.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you combine operational, commercial, and coordinating responsibilities within international ocean freight. You manage the full transport process from A to Z and act as the key link between internal teams and external partners. In addition, you lead a team and ensure structure, overview, and continuous process optimization.

The position is based in Breda, so you are willing to commute to this location on a daily basis.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate international deep-sea shipments (cross-trade)	
• Maintain contact and negotiate with shipping lines, forwarders, and suppliers	
• Book and follow up shipments until delivery	
• Manage and verify export documentation (B/Ls, L/Cs, Incoterms)	
• Analyze rates and optimize transport flows	
• Report to purchasing and sales teams	
• Lead and support a team (5 FTE)	
• Contribute to and implement improvements in operational processes

Your Profile
	
• 3 to 5 years of experience as a freight forwarder (deep sea), ready for the next step	
• Strong operational and commercial mindset	
• Experience with international transport within a trading environment is a plus	
• Good command of English (required); additional languages are an asset (Dutch not required)	
• Proactive, assertive, and strong communicator	
• Able to build relationships and identify opportunities	
• Strong organizational skills and sense of responsibility	
• Flexible mindset (willing to commute to Breda; international environment with multiple time zones)

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Join a Dynamic Team in Belgium!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you are key to ensuring our fleet runs smoothly. You carry out thorough diagnostics, repairs, and maintenance on DAF trucks. You view electrical issues as challenges and are comfortable reading electrical wiring diagrams. You test wiring harnesses, electrical systems, and control units, and communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about the work performed.

A typical day starts with a team meeting. Then, you work independently or with colleagues in our fully equipped workshop. You use the latest diagnostic equipment, keep up with the newest technical updates from the manufacturer, and coordinate with other mechanics when needed. Additionally, you provide technical support to our branch in Herent.

Are you looking for a technical role with variety, autonomy, and responsibility? Apply now and grow with our ambitious team!

• You have a high school diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent through experience.

• A professional or academic bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus.

• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector.

• Basic knowledge of electronics is required.

• You speak and understand Dutch fluently; knowledge of English is an asset.

• You are motivated, practical, and able to work independently.

• Leadership skills are a plus.

• A C(E) driver's license is an advantage but not required.
